items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: He had another guitarist, a marvelous guitarist by the name of Claude Adams.

ctx.x: I didn't play with his high school band, I was in school with him. He had another guitarist, a marvelous guitarist by the name of Claude Adams. Claude died very young but Ray always had very good bands. And I played with him later in a big band, and --
